text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one noted the venison chili was bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of water cups. One review mentioned the food was overpriced and minimal. Service concerns were less frequent but present.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate several issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Four reviews mention food quality concerns, including bland or poorly balanced dishes and limited flavor. Two reviews also note problems with service, such as not providing cups for water, and two mention wait times. There are comments about the limited menu range and the value for money, with at least one review calling the food overpriced. Overall, the average rating is below three, reflecting mixed to negative experiences.
windows.90: Visitor feedback over the last 90 days indicates several issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Multiple reviews mention bland or poorly prepared dishes, limited menu options, and dissatisfaction with specific items like salads and grilled cheese. There were also complaints about long wait times and inconsistent service, including periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. Some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the quality and selection. These concerns suggest a need to review menu offerings, improve food preparation, and address service efficiency.
